items.title: ProFTPD Improper Access Control Vulnerability
items.body: ProFTPD contains an improper access control vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to read and write to arbitrary files via the site cpfr and site cpto commands.

items.title: ISC BIND Data Processing Errors Vulnerability
items.body: ISC BIND contains a data processing errors vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to cause a denial of service via TKEY queries.

items.title: Apache Struts Command Injection Vulnerability
items.body: Apache Struts contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via method:prefix when Dynamic Method Invocation is enabled.

items.title: ONLYOFFICE Docs Server Path Traversal Vulnerability
items.body: ONLYOFFICE Docs contains a path traversal vulnerability that can occur when JWT is used, via a /.. sequence in an image upload parameter and could allow for remote code execution.

items.title: Strapi Cleartext Storage of Sensitive Information Vulnerability
items.body: Strapi contains a cleartext storage of sensitive information vulnerability that could allow attackers with access to the admin panel to discover sensitive user details via the query filter. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2023-22621 to achieve remote code execution.

items.title: Citrix NetScaler Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
items.body: Citrix NetScaler ADC (formerly Citrix ADC) and Citrix NetScaler Gateway (formerly Citrix Gateway) contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow for a denial of service.

items.title: Zammad GmbH Zammad Session Fixation Vulnerability
items.body: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains a session fixation vulnerability that can lead to remote code execution as the zammad user. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102490.

items.title: Zammad GmbH Zammad Improper Privilege Management Vulnerability
items.body: Zammad GmbH Zammad contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that can allow the local zammad user to escalate privileges to root. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-102489.

items.title: Fortinet FortiMail Path Traversal Vulnerability
items.body: Fortinet FortiMail contains a path traversal and an improper neutralization of NULL byte or NULL character vulnerability that may allow an unauthenticated attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying system via crafted HTTP or HTTPS requests.

items.title: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager Hex Encoding Vulnerability
items.body: Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager contains a hex encoding vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to access an affected system with privileges of the admin user due to improper handling of URI encoding in an HTTP request.

items.title: Apple Multiple Products Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
items.body: Apple iOS, macOS, and iPadOS contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in CoreGraphics that may lead to arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Citrix NetScaler Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
items.body: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper input validation vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands.

items.title: Citrix NetScaler Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer Vulnerability
items.body: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability that could allow for remote code execution or denial of service

items.title: Microsoft SharePoint Code Injection Vulnerability
items.body: Microsoft SharePoint contains a code injection vulnerability which could allow an authorized attacker to execute code over a network.

items.title: Mikrotik RouterOS Improper Enforcement of Behavioral Workflow Vulnerability
items.body: Mikrotik RouterOS contains an improper enforcement of behavioral workflow vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated client to open a session channel and send an exec request. This vulnerability can be chained to achieve unauthenticated exploitation of CVE-2026-86060.

items.title: WordPress Core Remote File Inclusion Vulnerability
items.body: WordPress Core contains a remote file inclusion vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated attacker to make page-template resolution include a chosen readable local `.php` file outside the active theme directories, leading to remote code execution.

items.title: WSO2 Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
items.body: WSO2 API Control Plane, API Manager, Traffic Manager & Universal Gateway contain a path traversal vulnerability that could allow for unrestricted file upload and lead to remote code execution.

items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
items.body: Adobe Commerce and Magento contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that could allow an attacker to leverage this vulnerability to gain elevated access to sensitive resources without any user interaction.

items.title: Check Point Multiple Products Improper Certificate Validation Vulnerability
items.body: Check Point Security Gateway and Check Point Spark Firewall using Site to Site VPN or Remote Access VPN contain an improper certificate validation vulnerability which could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code on the Gateway.

items.title: Check Point Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
items.body: Check Point Security Management Server, Multi-Domain Security Management Server, Log Server, Multi-Domain Log Server, and SmartEvent contain a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to upload and execute arbitrary scripts.

items.title: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
items.body: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator (VCO) on-prem contains an improper input validation vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker to access privileged internal functionality and impact the VCO host. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and data managed by the orchestrator.

items.title: F5 BIG-IP APM Heap-based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
items.body: F5 BIG-IP APM contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability when access policy and an OAuth profile are configured on a virtual server. This vulnerability could allow an unauthenticated attacker to perform remote code execution.

items.title: Zyxel GS1900 Series Switches Stack-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
items.body: Zyxel GS1900 series switches contain a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the CGI program which could allow a LAN-based, unauthenticated attacker to exploit the flaw and potentially execute OS commands via a crafted HTTP request.

items.title: Linux Kernel Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions Vulnerability
items.body: Linux Kernel contains an improper check for unusual or exceptional conditions vulnerability in the TLS receive path which allows a zero-length record retrieved from the rx_list to bypass the intended recvmsg() record-type handling, potentially causing subsequent TLS records to be processed using incorrect zero-copy and queuing assumptions. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

items.title: Linux Kernel Race Condition Vulnerability
items.body: Linux Kernel contains a race condition vulnerability which allows concurrent writes to the same AF_ALG socket causing data to be unpredictably interleaved and creating inconsistencies in the socket's internal state.

items.title: Linux Kernel Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
items.body: Linux Kernel contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the ebtables SNAT target which allows an ARP sender hardware address rewrite to write directly into a nonlinear socket-buffer fragment backed by a splice-imported file page. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

items.title: Google Pixel Improper Authorization Vulnerability
items.body: Google Pixel devices contain an improper authorization vulnerability in the cellular modem. A logic error may allow an attacker to bypass permission checks and escalate privileges.

items.title: Cisco Identity Services Engine Incorrect Use of Privileged APIs Vulnerability
items.body: Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) and Cisco ISE Passive Identity Connector (ISE-PIC) contain an incorrect use of privileged APIs vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to gain unauthorized access to the affected device by bypassing the web-based management interface.

items.title: Acronis Backup Incorrect Default Permissions Vulnerability
items.body: Acronis Backup plugin for cPanel & WHM and extension for Plesk contains an incorrect default permissions vulnerability that could allow for privilege escalation.

items.title: Cisco Secure Email Gateway SQL Injection Vulnerability
items.body: Cisco AsyncOS software for Cisco Secure Email Gateway (SEG) contains a SQL injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands with root privileges on the underlying operating system.

items.title: JFrog Artifactory Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
items.body: JFrog Artifactory contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that leads to a privilege escalation attack due to a validation check of the token signature/issuer and not the token’s scope.

items.title: JFrog Artifactory Improper Authentication Vulnerability
items.body: JFrog Artifactory contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could return an internal anonymous-user token to an unauthenticated caller when anonymous access is disabled, potentially exposing sensitive resources.

items.title: ConnectWise ScreenConnect Improper Privilege Management and Missing Authorization Vulnerability
items.body: ConnectWise ScreenConnect contains both an improper privilege management and missing authorization vulnerability that may allow an attacker to transfer and execute files through an active remote session without authorization or host confirmation.

items.title: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition Path Traversal Vulnerability
items.body: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated user to read arbitrary files due to an improper path confinement and missing authentication enforcement in the repository commits API.

items.title: MikroTik RouterOS Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
items.body: MikroTik RouterOS contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which allows kernel memory disclosure and denial of service in the btest service.

items.title: MikroTik RouterOS Improper Neutralization of Argument Delimiters in a Command Vulnerability
items.body: MikroTik RouterOS contains an improper neutralization of argument delimiters in a command vulnerability which allows an attacker to change the trusted RouterOS policy mask, leading to privilege escalation.

items.title: Fortinet Multiple Products Heap-based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
items.body: Fortinet FortiOS, FortiSwitchManager, and FortiSASE contain a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows an attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands via specially crafted packets.

items.title: Citrix NetScaler Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
items.body: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an authentication-bypass vulnerability involving an alternate path or channel. When the NetScaler appliance is configured as an AAA virtual server or as a Gateway (SSL VPN, ICA Proxy, CVPN, or RDP Proxy), an unauthenticated remote threat actor may be able to bypass authentication.

items.title: Cisco Firewall Management Center Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
items.body: Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) Software and Cisco Security Cloud Control (SCC) Firewall Management contain an authentication Bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to bypass authentication and execute script files on an affected device to obtain root access to the underlying operating system.

items.title: Google Chromium V8 Out of Bounds Write Vulnerability
items.body: Google Chromium V8 contains an out of bounds write vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine Vulnerability
items.body: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source contain an improper neutralization of special elements used in a template engine vulnerability that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code.

items.title: Microsoft Windows Link Following Vulnerability
items.body: Microsoft Windows Update Stack contains a link following vulnerability that allows a local attacker to escalate privileges locally up to SYSTEM.

items.title: Microsoft Windows Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
items.body: Microsoft Windows Advanced Local Procedure Call contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows an attacker to elevate privileges locally.

items.title: N-able N-central Static Code Injection Vulnerability
items.body: N-able N-central contains a static code injection vulnerability that could allow for pre-authentication remote code execution.

items.title: Google Chromium V8 Type Confusion Vulnerability
items.body: Google Chromium V8 contains a type confusion vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

items.title: Kludex Starlette HTTP Request/Response Smuggling Vulnerability
items.body: Kludex Starlette contains a HTTP request/response smuggling vulnerability that could allow attackers to inject paths into the host part, prepending the actual path leading to issues such as authentication bypass when the authentication depends on the reconstructed URL’s path. This vulnerability could be chaned with CVE-2026-42271.

items.title: Kestra OSS OS Command Injection Vulnerability
items.body: Kestra OSS contains an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to create and execute arbitrary workflows without credentials.

items.title: BerriAI LiteLLM Improper Authentication Vulnerability
items.body: BerriAI LiteLLM contains an improper authentication vulnerability in the MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to establish an authenticated MCP session using an arbitrary Bearer token.

items.title: JFrog Artifactory Improper Authentication Vulnerability
items.body: JFrog Artifactory contains an improper authentication vulnerability that under default configuration can allow an unauthenticated attacker with network access to obtain administrative privileges.

items.title: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances Server-Side Request Forgery Vulnerability
items.body: SonicWall SMA1000 Appliances contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that could allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to gain unauthorized access to sensitive functionality and perform unauthorized operations.
